decisions.rationale: The span "breast and ovarian cancer" contiguously refers to two separate diseases, breast cancer and ovarian cancer, sharing the head term "cancer". Splitting it would lose information, as with "colorectal, endometrial, and ovarian cancers", so it is annotated as one Composite Mention.
decisions.guideline_section: Annotation Guidelines Section 2 (Annotate contiguous text strings) and Examples 7 (Composite Mention)
